subject: VM evidence & SLA exception / remediation attestation for SIG review
messages:
From: Jae Lee <security@finbridge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM evidence for SIG / CVE-2028-2345

Vivek —

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG review we need confirmation of Redwood's vulnerability management cadence and remediation SLAs for medium/high CVEs. Specifically: 

- Last three months of authenticated scanning cadence (schedule and dates)
- Evidence that CVE-2028-2345 was triaged and remediated (or mitigated) to our 45-day target
- Any SLA exceptions or compensating controls in place during remediation windows

Can you provide the scan summary, the remediation log for CVE-2028-2345, and an attestation PDF we can archive? Ideally we need these artifacts by EOD Wed 13 Jun for our audit committee.

Thanks,
Jae
Jae Lee
Security Engineer, FinBridge

Date: Sat, 10 Jun 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence for SIG / CVE-2028-2345

Thanks Jae — I'm on it. Quick notes: 

- We'll bundle the last 90 days of authenticated scan summaries (weekly cadence), the raw remediation log for the CVE you call out, and a signed attestation.
- There was one SLA exception during that window (linked to a cross-cluster patching delay). I'm attaching the exception log and a short explanation; Marissa will add the remediation timelines and the signed attestation.

Two asks for you: confirm whether FinBridge needs the raw Nessus export or the consolidated PDF summary (we can provide both if you want).

I'll aim to get a consolidated packet to you by COB Tue 13 Jun.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 13 Jun 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence for SIG / CVE-2028-2345

Hi all — attaching the items Vivek referenced. Attachment stubs below: 

- redwood-weekly-scan-202804-202806-summary.pdf (consolidated authenticated scan summaries; contains dates and scan coverage matrix)
- cve-2028-2345-remediation-log.csv (timeline: detection->triage->PR->deploy->verify)
- sla-exception-log-20280615.xlsx (single row exception with root cause and timeline)
- vm-attestation-20280615.pdf (signed attestation draft)

Notes in-line: 
- CVE-2028-2345: discovered 2028-04-22 (internal dynamic test), triaged 2028-04-23, fix PR merged 2028-05-02, staged rollout 05-06 -> 05-09, verified 05-11. That meets our 45-day SLA.
- SLA exception: 2028-05-20 to 2028-05-22 — patch orchestration failed for a subset of Dedicated nodes due to a kernel mismatch; mitigation was to route traffic and apply an urgent hotpatch. We documented compensating controls (traffic steering + increased monitoring) in the attached spreadsheet.

We're including a DocuSign link at the top of vm-attestation-20280615.pdf for signature. Vivek — two small asks: 1) can you review the attestation language (paragraph 3, compensating controls) and 2) if sign-off looks good, I'll send the DocuSign to Jae.

Marissa
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: FINAL: VM attestation and evidence packet (FinBridge SIG)

Jae — attached is the final evidence packet. I reviewed and approved the attestation language; Marissa sent it via DocuSign and it's completed. Attached files (same as the draft):

- redwood-weekly-scan-202804-202806-summary.pdf (PDF, consolidated)
- cve-2028-2345-remediation-log.csv (CSV, remediation timeline + ticket IDs)
- sla-exception-log-20280615.xlsx (XLSX, exception entry + mitigation timeline)
- vm-attestation-20280615.pdf (PDF, signed attestation — DocuSign record: 0a1b2c3d-finbridge-20280615)

Summary of commitments for your archive: 
- Scan cadence: authenticated weekly scans across all customer-facing clusters; internal incremental scans daily for critical services.
- SLA: 45 days for medium/high CVEs; documented process for escalation and hotpatching.
- Exception: single documented SLA exception May 20–22 with compensating controls enacted; root cause fixed and steps added to patch orchestration runbook.

If you need the raw scanner exports (Nessus/Qualys) or specific ticket links, say the word and we will provide them under your NDA.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
